Titan Chief of Staff — Windows 10/11 local overlay

Double-click TitanCOS.exe. That is the whole launch.

Chrome opens. If Eleads asks, sign in as Bordine, Glenn on 28206 or 28546.
Titan never types the password. After that session is live, the overlay stays on
screen and COS works both rooftops in a continuous local loop. No cloud tokens.

COS.cmd does the same one-click start if you prefer a script.

Optional older path (not required once TitanCOS.exe is on the PC):
  INSTALL.cmd copies files into %LOCALAPPDATA%\TitanChief\app and arms kill.switch.
  TitanCOS.exe also self-installs on first double-click.

Do not type verify by itself. Command Prompt owns that word.
Do not type Titan.cmd from C:\Windows\system32.
Rooftops 28206 and 28546 only. Never 6220.
Needs Google Chrome. The published folder is self-contained — no extra .NET install.
